facts.note: counted at the grain used for the references: the 30-man test stopped after three runs; the king at war orders 72 guns; two gun decks + carvings; the launch crowd and sails; gust/rights/second gust/ports under, sinks 1,300 m out, ~30 dead; the inquiry blames no one ('Only God knows'); the weighted-toy principle; bronze guns over 120 t of stone; twice the ballast would sink the ports; raised 1961, in Stockholm today. Top-8 maximum is 7: it reads as a fact list

jokes.note: no line is written for a laugh; 'Only God knows, one builder says' and 'The admiral wishes the king were home' are wry at most

reversal.note: 'the ship was already warning them' turns the opening test into the warning everyone ignored

ridicule.note: nobody mocks the test or the admiral on the page; the king's letters overrule him but no one laughs or jeers

mechanism_visible.note: heavy guns high, light stone low, open ports reaching the water: physical and drawable

shootable_share.note: all but 'The admiral wishes the king were home' name a concrete thing (that one needs a face close-up)

hook_act_on_screen.note: 'Thirty sailors ran back and forth across a brand-new warship' = frame 0
